caption:
15.4%.

Thirteen teams have started 0-2 since 2021, and exactly two of them crawled into the playoffs.

Erick, 2021: snuck in as the 4 seed, then got bounced in the first round by Jason on a Monday night. Saved just long enough to lose to the commish.

Hoa, 2024: rode it all the way to the championship, where David beat him. That's the best case for an 0-2 team in this league. You go on a miracle run and still lose the final.

The other eleven finished around 10th on average. Three of them finished dead last.

The 2026 0-2 club: David, who had never started 0-2 before and just got hung with a 200. Drew, who posted 84.38, which is basically a bye with extra steps. And Zack, whose third 0-2 start in four years makes it less of a slump than a way of life.

Nobody has ever started 0-2 and won this league.
